8170.title: Codex event scans persist an unchanged cursor
8170.rootCauseOneLine: The async-question reader unconditionally persists its cursor after scanning, including when no extension-state rows advanced it.

prReviews.topFinding: Advancement-only persistence matches the reproduced cause; no PR code was run.

8170.proposedFix: Retain the cursor loaded at entry and persist only when the final scanned cursor is greater; preserve pagination and advancement for all scanned extension-state rows.
8170.caveats: No live-provider or file-WAL timing benchmark. No new fix PR because open PR #8171 already closes this issue.
